standard_prerequisites.name: Properness and flatness of relative dimension are preserved by base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, labels morphisms-lemma-base-change-proper (proof line 2422), morphisms-lemma-base-change-relative-dimension-d and morphisms-lemma-base-change-flat (proof lines 2424-2425)

standard_prerequisites.name: The cycle class of a closed subscheme, flat pullback and proper pushforward of cycle classes, and cohomology and base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-cycle-closed-coherent (proof line 2429, claimed at a withdrawn revision), lemma-cycle-push-sheaf (proof line 2430) and lemma-pullback-coherent (proof line 2431); Cohomology of Schemes, label coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology (proof line 2435)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the equality of cycles to an isomorphism of the two pushforwards of the structure sheaf of an integral component, which is the flat base change theorem.

core_obligations: Settle properness and flatness of the base change by the standard preservation statements (proof lines 2420-2425).

Reduce to an integral class: it suffices to prove the equality for the class of an integral closed subscheme of the relevant dimension, and that class may be replaced by the cycle class of its structure sheaf (proof lines 2426-2429).

Conclude by base change: using the two statements identifying pushforwards and pullbacks of cycle classes, it suffices to show that the pushforward of the pulled back structure sheaf equals the pullback of the pushforward, which is the cohomology and base change statement for a flat base change (proof lines 2430-2435).
proof_roadmap: Preservation statements for properness and flatness (proof lines 2420-2425).
Reduction to an integral class via the structure sheaf (proof lines 2426-2429).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that flat pullback commutes with proper pushforward in a fibre product square, for cycles (statement lines 2400-2418, tag 02R1-adjacent). The proof records the preservation of properness and of flatness of relative dimension under base change, reduces to the class of an integral closed subscheme via the structure sheaf, and then reduces the cycle equality to the cohomology and base change isomorphism for the structure sheaf. The two reductions are the substance, so the claim is H2.
